info.title: ExtraWork API
info.description:
WhatsApp-first contract-change and approval ledger.

Three surfaces: `/v1` (authenticated business), `/public/v1` (no-account customer approval), `/webhooks/v1` (provider callbacks). Money is always integer minor units. Quantities are decimal strings. Instants are ISO-8601 UTC.

get.summary: People with access to the project, and its invitations
get.description: Organization-wide staff and everyone with a grant on the project. Invitations are listed only for callers who may invite; everyone else gets an empty list.

post.summary: Invite someone from another firm (or the homeowner) by email
post.description: Designers only. Re-inviting a pending address refreshes the invitation (new link, new 14-day expiry). The invite URL is returned once and emailed; only its SHA-256 is stored. A WhatsApp number (not for HOMEOWNER) also adds the person to the project's site team.

delete.summary: Remove a person's access to the project
delete.description: Refused for organization-wide staff, who see every project by role. A collaborator who loses their last project loses the workspace membership and its sessions.

get.summary: Live invitations addressed to the signed-in user's email
get.description: Needs a session but not an organization, so a person with no workspace can see what they were invited to.

post.summary: Accept an invitation with its link token
post.description: Needs a session (and CSRF) but not an organization. The session's email must equal the invited address. Moves the session's active workspace to the host.

post.summary: Accept one of the signed-in user’s pending invitations by id

get.summary: Preview an invitation before signing in
get.description: Public. Who invited which (masked) address to which project. Rate-limited by hashed token and IP; noindex.

post.summary: Raise a request for the designer to review
post.description: Creates a DRAFT with review provenance. It may be incomplete (no price yet); the designer completes it and sends it, or dismisses it. Origin is PASTED when `pasted` is set, COLLABORATOR for a collaborator, otherwise WEB. `raisedByEmployeeId` is accepted from designer roles only and must be on the project.

post.summary: Dismiss a proposal without sending it
post.description: Designer roles only, and only while the request awaits review (409 NOT_AWAITING_REVIEW otherwise). Cancels the draft and tells whoever raised it why.

post.summary: Mark an approved change as invoiced
post.description: Owner, admin or accounts. Bookkeeping only: outside the frozen snapshot. Rejected unless the current version is APPROVED.

post.summary: Read a pasted WhatsApp message (creates nothing)
post.description: Paste-to-draft. Returns what was read, what is missing and the matched project, chosen only among projects the caller can see.

post.summary: Share the project with a homeowner
post.description: Issues a private, no-account link to a contact of the project's customer (the default approver when none is given), valid 1–365 days (default 90). The URL is returned once with a wa.me share link and the message text; only its SHA-256 is stored.

201.description: The link and its one-time URL

delete.description: Idempotent. The link stops working at once.

get.summary: The homeowner portal: one project, as the homeowner may see it
get.description: Public. The project summary, its contract value and history, every request that was ever sent (latest sent version; never drafts or proposals still with the designer), documents in CLIENT folders only, and client-visible milestones. Rate-limited by hashed token and IP; no-store, noindex, no-referrer. A revoked or expired link is PORTAL_LINK_INVALID with `details.reason`.

post.summary: The homeowner asks for a change
post.description: Public. Becomes a proposal (origin PORTAL) on the designer’s review queue, attributed to the link’s contact; nothing is priced or sent. Rate-limited per link (10 a day).
